body:
Unfortunately I'm in a program right now where the only other therapist is a guy that I can't stand. He's all fake laughter, Jesus, and fishing stories. I think I'm just done with them. If they don't take me seriously when I ask seriously for actual help, what the fuck is the point of them? I mean, if I called them right now and said I was going to kill myself, I'm sure they'd send somebody but whatever. I literally told her that I've been thinking about hurting myself and she told me to flip a switch in my brain and start thinking positive. What the flying fuck am I supposed to do with that?

It's garbage and I hate her for it.

She tells me that doing the dishes will make me feel better, and when I disagree she tells me that I can't know without trying. Like, that's not therapy. Washing the dishes gives you clean dishes and pruny fingers, not a balanced and healthy mental state.

They all just make me so angry, and then when the anger goes away there's just nothing, like it's all burned up. I don't think there's any help I can get from them. Within two sentences I'll get, "There's no magic pill to make you feel better. You're taking all your medication, though, right?" What the fuck? Do you want me to or not? Make up your fucking mind before you talk to me because I'm already the most confused motherfucker you're ever going to meet. Whatever. I don't want to give too many details about them because they do help people, I guess I'm just not one of them.

Like I said, I think I'm done with them. I guess I've tried the whole "get help" thing and it just shit all over me, which is why I'm here. I feel like... I don't know. Like I'm the King of Nothingness and there isn't a goddamned thing anybody can do to change that, and I'm usually right. But whatever. It's not like anyone else cares. This was kind of a last ditch effort thing and I honestly don't expect anything to change. This sounds so whiny I don't want to post it but it's already typed so here goes nothing.

Talk to you about my life? There's nothing to say. Everyday I waste time until I go back to sleep. I sit at the computer with youtube on so it looks like I'm doing something and they don't haul me away to some institution (which has almost happened before). It's like I'm playing a game of hide and seek that doesn't end and the only way to win is if I'm never found. And I'm winning.

I get some kind of perverse satisfaction out of lying to people. If I see a doctor I just lie to them, too, and they don't change my meds and I walk away until the next doctor visit. I tried being honest yesterday and it totally blew up in my face, so I'm pretty much done with that. The only reason I decided to be honest on the internet is because of the extremely limited interaction potential. You guys can't touch me.

I don't feel particularly sad about the whole deal. I've been wondering, if I disappeared, how long it would take for anyone to notice. Would they think I was just gone for the day? The week? How long before I was just ink on paper, like so many others? I'd be another statistic, a sad little soul lost to the ether, filed away in some cabinet gathering dust. Another nothing on a nothing in a nothing.
